How the odds work

Each team starts from a projected win total and is updated with every result (the projection counts like 30 games, so early records move it but don't take over). We then simulate the rest of the 82-game season 20,000 times, with some uncertainty in every team's strength, and count how often each team finishes top six and top ten in its conference. This is model v0: it uses records only, not injuries, schedule strength or point differential.

Sources4 sources · where every number comes from
  1. FOX Sports NBA standingsUsed for: Wins, losses and conference rank after each night (backup: CBS Sports standings)
  2. CBS Sports NBA standingsUsed for: Backup standings when FOX hasn't updated yet
  3. Game results: our nightly box-score feedUsed for: Last night's scores, checked against the standings before anything changes
  4. Box & Motion playoff model v0Used for: Projected win totals saved Oct 30, updated with every result; 20,000 simulations of the rest of the season
